actions.description: Create up to 200 rows in a single request.
actions.name: batch-create-rows

items.description: Row field objects to create. Each object uses field_<id> keys (or display names when userFieldNames is true). Minimum 1, maximum 200.

userFieldNames.description: If true, use user-specified field names instead of field_<id> keys in request and response.

before.description: If provided, inserts all new rows immediately before the row with this id.

actions.description: Delete up to 200 rows in a single request.
actions.name: batch-delete-rows

items.description: Array of 1 to 200 row IDs to delete. Example: [15, 16]

actions.description: Update up to 200 rows in a single request.
actions.name: batch-update-rows

items.description: Row update payload. Must include id plus only the fields being changed.

userFieldNames.description: If true, use field display names instead of field_<id> keys in the request and response.

actions.description: Verify that the configured database token is valid.
actions.name: check-token

actions.description: Create a row in a table.
actions.name: create-row

tableId.description: The ID of the table to create the row in. Example: 1080602

fields.description: Field values to set. Keys are field_<id> by default, or display names when userFieldNames is true.

userFieldNames.description: If true, use field display names as keys in fields and response.

before.description: Row ID to insert the new row immediately before. Omit to append at the end.

actions.description: Get a single row by id.
actions.name: get-row

userFieldNames.description: Return field names instead of field IDs.

actions.description: List the fields (columns) of a table.
actions.name: list-fields

tableId.description: The ID of the table to list fields for. Example: 1080602

fields.description: The list of fields in the table.

actions.description: Look up display names (primary field values) for specific rows across one or more tables.
actions.name: list-row-names

tables.description: Map of table IDs to arrays of row IDs to look up. Example: {"1080602": [1, 2]}

names.description: Map of table IDs to maps of row IDs to primary field values. Example: {"1080602": {"1": "Design UI"}}

actions.description: List rows in a table with optional filtering, search, sorting, and pagination
actions.name: list-rows

orderBy.description: Comma-separated field ids or display names. Example: field_9571320 or -field_9571320 for descending

filter.description: Filter params. Keys like filter__field_<id>__<type>, values are filter values

filterType.description: Filter logic when multiple filter params are provided

filters.description: JSON-serialized filter tree. If present, all filter__ params are ignored

viewId.description: View ID to inherit stored filters and sorts

include.description: Comma-separated field names or field_<id> to include

exclude.description: Comma-separated field names or field_<id> to exclude

userFieldNames.description: When true, response keys and order_by/include/exclude use display names instead of field_<id>

actions.description: List all tables the database token can access.
actions.name: list-tables

actions.description: Move a row to a new position (reorder within the table).
actions.name: move-row

beforeId.description: Row ID to move immediately before. Omit to move to the end of the table.

fields.description: Partial row fields to update. Keys are field_<id> or display names when user_field_names is true.

userFieldNames.description: If true, use display names as field keys instead of field_<id>.

actions.description: Verify a password value against a Password-type field on a row.
actions.name: verify-password-field

field_id.description: The ID of the password field to verify against. Example: 9574050

row_id.description: The ID of the row containing the password. Example: 1

password.description: The plaintext password to verify. Example: "NangoTest123!"

syncs.description: Sync field (column) definitions for a configured table
syncs.name: fields

syncs.description: Sync rows for a configured table
syncs.name: rows

syncs.description: Sync all tables visible to the database token.
syncs.name: tables
